title: Schriever disc test flight in Prague

tellings.quote: Kammler recruited Rudolf Schriever, a German technician who claims to have worked on a disc-shaped craft in Prague that made its first test flight in February of 1945, climbing to 40,000 ft in 3 minutes.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says a man named Hans Kammler recruited Rudolf Schriever, a German technician who claimed to have worked on a disc-shaped flying craft in Prague. According to Schriever's claim as Michels retells it, the disc made its first test flight in February 1945 and climbed to 40,000 feet in three minutes, which if true would mean wartime Germany had built a working flying saucer.
